subject: Case study interview: RidgeView Analytics
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@ridgeview.ai>, Ben Cho <ben.cho@ridgeview.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Case study interview: RidgeView Analytics

Hi Samira and Ben —

Thanks again for agreeing to consider a short case study with Redwood. Wed love to capture a 30–45 minute discovery interview with the stakeholders who own model evaluation and production metrics (so we can highlight the measurable outcomes youve seen).

High-level ask: can we schedule a 30–45 minute interview in the next two weeks? During the call wed like to cover:
- primary business goals you used Redwood to address (throughput, cost, reliability)
- one or two concrete metrics (p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, throughput deltas) you can share
- screenshots/metrics youre comfortable sharing for the case study
- approval and review timeline for any final quote/pull-quote

Preliminary availability from my side: Mon Feb 29 10:00–11:00 PT, Tue Mar 2 13:00–15:00 PT, Wed Mar 3 09:00–11:00 PT. If you prefer, send a Calendly link and Ill book.

One important note on recording/consent: we record these calls for note-taking and transcription. Ive attached a short recording consent form and a metrics snapshot template we use for customers to populate. If you have any constraints (e.g., embargo around public release until your Q2 product launch), please flag that upfront.

Attachments: RidgeView_Metrics_Snapshot.pdf, Redwood_Recording_Consent.docx

Thanks — happy to adjust scope.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@ridgeview.ai>

Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Case study interview: RidgeView Analytics

Thanks, Laura — we'd be glad to participate. High level: RidgeViews analytics team (myself), Ben (Head of Platform), and Emily Park (Marketing) will be involved. For technical detail wed also like to include our ML infra lead if available — Ill confirm a name.

Availability works best on Mar 3 or Mar 4 in the windows you suggested. Prefer a 45-minute slot so we can run through numbers. Two quick questions:
1) Can you confirm the exact recording consent language? We need to make sure it allows a review period and optional embargo.
2) Does Redwood need any additional documentation ahead of time (SLA excerpts, a short list of the metrics you want filled)?

Ben, looping you to confirm whether 3/3 or 3/4 is better on your side.

—Samira
Head of Analytics | RidgeView Analytics
samira.khan@ridgeview.ai

Hi Samira —

Great to hear youre open to this. A few operational details from our side so the session is focused and publishable: 
- Agenda (30–45m): 1) brief intros and scope (5m), 2) technical setup and metrics walk-through (15–20m), 3) business impact / outcomes / quotes (10m), 4) next steps and review cadence (5–10m).
- Well ask you to fill the attached metrics snapshot before the call; it helps speed the interview and prevents long post-call follow-ups.
- Recording/consent: attaching a short consent doc. Our standard practice: we record for internal notes, Redwood transcribes, and we share a draft case study for your review with a 7-business-day review window before publishing. If you need an embargo (e.g., until your feature launch), well respect that. Please sign the consent and return it.

If Mar 3 works, how about Tue Mar 3 at 10:30 AM PT? If thats tight, Laura suggested Mar 2 13:30–14:15 or Mar 4 09:30–10:15.

Attachments: Redwood_Recording_Consent.docx, RidgeView_Metrics_Snapshot.pdf

Ill also include Marissa from CS (ccd) — shell run the production-impact questions and help draft the customer quote.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@ridgeview.ai>

Thanks, Rafael — Mar 3 at 10:30 AM PT works for our team. Weve attached the signed consent (RidgeView_Consent_Signed.pdf). A couple of flags from our side: please hold public distribution until we confirm the Q2 PR window (tentative embargo through Apr 15) and redact any internal-only revenue figures — we can provide percentage deltas instead.

Per your agenda, Emily will handle the approvals/review timeline and Marissa (ccd) will present the production impact and observed latency gains. Our ML infra lead (Amit Patel) will join for the technical portion.

We look forward to the call and will populate the metrics snapshot by end of day tomorrow.

Cheers,
Samira Khan

samira.khan@ridgeview.ai
